atlas: AXOM Comprehensive Atlas of Human Disease & Pathology V2
chapter: Respiratory Pathology: Infection, Obstruction, Vascular, Interstitial, Sleep and Pleural Disorders

entries.name: Tuberculosis
entries.discriminator: Airborne M. tuberculosis, caseating granulomas, active diagnosis by sputum molecular tests, culture and susceptibility; regimen depends on resistance

entries.name: Pulmonary embolism
entries.discriminator: Thrombus blocks pulmonary vascular bed, acute right ventricular afterload and hypoxemia; risk-based anticoagulation and intervention

entries.name: ARDS / diffuse alveolar damage
entries.discriminator: Clinical acute hypoxemic permeability edema, often DAD histology; not interchangeable with DAD in isolation; lung protective ventilation and prone positioning

entries.name: COPD: emphysema
entries.discriminator: Irreversible distal airspace enlargement from alveolar septal destruction; establish airflow obstruction with post-bronchodilator spirometry

entries.name: Asthma
entries.discriminator: Variable expiratory airflow limitation with airway inflammation; ICS-containing reliever strategy vs SABA monotherapy for most adults/adolescents

entries.name: Bronchiectasis
entries.discriminator: Permanently dilated conducting bronchi with recurrent infection/mucus retention; airway clearance, risk-directed macrolide or inhaled therapy

entries.name: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis / UIP
entries.discriminator: Progressive fibrotic interstitial lung disease after exclusion of known causes; basal subpleural reticulation, honeycombing and fibroblastic foci; UIP morphology not diagnostic of etiology alone

entries.name: Lung adenocarcinoma
entries.discriminator: Malignant glandular pulmonary epithelium with acinar, lepidic, solid or mucinous patterns; biomarker-genotype therapy and staging required

entries.name: Pulmonary arterial hypertension (WHO group 1)
entries.discriminator: Precapillary pulmonary hypertension by right heart catheterization; evaluate idiopathic, heritable and associated causes and exclude group 2-5 phenotypes

entries.name: Malignant pleural mesothelioma
entries.discriminator: Diffuse pleural mesothelial malignant neoplasm, usually asbestos-associated; invasive pattern and mesothelial immunohistochemistry to separate carcinoma

entries.name: Spontaneous pneumothorax
entries.discriminator: Air in pleural space without direct trauma, with tension physiology requiring immediate decompression based on clinical suspicion

entries.name: Obstructive sleep apnea-hypopnea syndrome
entries.discriminator: Repetitive upper airway collapse in sleep causing apnea/hypopnea; objective sleep monitoring, positive airway pressure, adherence review
